parties.respondent_defendant: Defendant wife (Hansaben @ Hinaben C Parmar D/O Chamlal M Parmar)

facts_of_case: Appellant husband instituted Hindu Marriage Petition No.160 of 2003 against respondent wife for getting decree of divorce under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act. Appellant contended that respondent had deserted him and there was cruelty by wife. Trial Court disbelieved appellant's case and held that due to cruelty by appellant, respondent was compelled to leave house and stay with her parents.

legal_principles.principle: In cases of irretrievable breakdown of marriage, the Court is bound to grant divorce.
legal_principles.held: As observed and held by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Naveen Kohil v/s. Neelu Kohli reported in AIR 2006 SC 1675 as well as in the case of Satish Sitole v/s. Ganga reported in AIR 2008 SC 3093.
cited_cases: Naveen Kohil v/s. Neelu Kohli (2006) SC 1675

outcome.final_order: Present Second Appeal under Section 100 of Code of Civil Procedure has been preferred by the Appellant husband challenging the judgment and order passed by the Courts below refusing to grant decree of divorce.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
preparing a case for maintenance and alimony
assisting in a joint family dispute
